title: Cursed mobs
description: This is a recource pack that makes some mobs cursed
body:
This recource pack makes some the following mobs cursed:
Warden
Baby Chicken
Chicken
Cow
Breeze
Endermite
Creeper
Baby Wolf
Copper golem
Pig
Drowned
Baby Villager
Enderman

Please report any bugs in the discord server
